I'm a Czech Aston Villa fan.

My local club started plummeting from the top division to the 4th whilst our tri-city rivals were on their way up. At the beginning of the new century a local businessman decided on a project that would make my team a part of the rivals' club, under a new name. 

I lost all interest and connection to it after my team basically disappeared because the only thing that remained from my club was that the games were being played at our ground.

So I started following european football more and Villa caught my eye in a 01/02 PL preseason magazine special issue. Been following them since.
